bagPolicy.summary: At Honda Center, bags for Ducks games must be no larger than 4 in. x 6 in. x 1.5 in., while for non-Ducks events, bags can be up to 5 in. x 9 in. x 2 in. Backpacks of any size are not allowed.
allowed: Bags up to 4 in. x 6 in. x 1.5 in. for Ducks games
Bags up to 5 in. x 9 in. x 2 in. for non-Ducks events
bagPolicy.note: Medical and diaper bags up to 12 in. x 12 in. x 12 in. are allowed with additional screening.

parking.note: General parking at onsite lots and garages is included with event tickets, with no separate parking pass required. Accessible parking is available on a first-come, first-parked basis. Guests are encouraged to arrive early and use alternative transportation options.

rideshare.note: Rideshare and taxi drop off and pick up are available at ARTIC at 2626 East Katella Avenue, Anaheim 92806.

concessions.note: Honda Center offers a variety of food and drink options across different levels, including personal pizzas, wings, burgers, tacos, and specialty desserts. Unique offerings include a dedicated wine cellar with over 270 bottles and self-pour beer selections. Concession availability may vary due to ongoing renovations.
stands: THE WINE CELLAR PRESERVED BY SUB-ZERO

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Please call the Honda Center box office at 714-704-2500 to request relocation or if you have specific questions regarding wheelchair-accessible and companion seating. Honda Center provides wheelchair-accessible and companion seating on each level of the arena, including the floor when the event offers floor seats.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: In an effort to continue the highest level of safety and security, Honda Center enforces a “no re-entry” policy for all ticketed events.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is located at the box office and opens one and a half hours prior to the event start time.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Honda Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
